extracted.name: Homemade Italian Dressing
extracted.description: This vinaigrette-style homemade Italian dressing is zesty, bright, and full of bold, fresh flavor. It takes only about 5 minutes to prepare with a mix of pantry staples and a few fresh ingredients.
ingredient_lines: 1 Tablespoon finely chopped red bell pepper
1 teaspoon honey or granulated sugar (imperative for flavor balance)
instruction_lines: Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl or a jar with a tight-fitting lid. Whisk or shake until the mixture is well combined. Taste the dressing and add more seasonings if desired.
Store the dressing in an airtight container or jar in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. Shake well before using.
